from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def process_refund_request(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    requested_by: str,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    idempotency_key: str | None = None,
) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.
    """
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("payment_refunded"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{refunded + amount} > {payment.amount}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount == payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment

from .errors import BillingError

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def to_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Convert an int, str or Decimal into a Decimal amount."""
    if isinstance(value, (bool, float)):
        raise BillingError("float_amount", f"refusing to convert {value!r}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return value
    try:
        return Decimal(str(value))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(value)) from None


def round_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Round to the cent using the finance team's rounding policy."""
    return to_money(value).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-03: support-initiated refunds and credits above this
# amount require a second approver.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = Decimal("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment: Payment,
    amount,
    requested_by: str,
    at: datetime,
    *,
    approved_by: str | None = None,
    idempotency_key: str | None = None,
) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent.

    ``amount`` is the text the support agent typed; it is rounded to the cent.
    Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and
    the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.

    Refunds above ``APPROVAL_THRESHOLD`` require a second approver per finance
    policy FIN-2026-03; pass their user id as ``approved_by``.
    """
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("payment_refunded"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund of {amount} exceeds {APPROVAL_THRESHOLD} and needs a second approver",
        )

    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{refunded + amount} > {payment.amount}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount == payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
EOF

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"49.999","u",T0); print("rounded", p.refunded_amount)

p=mk("100.00"); process_refund_request(p,"10.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k"); process_refund_request(p,"10.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k"); print("idem", p.refunded_amount)
# exceeds
p=mk("100.00")
try: process_refund_request(p,"100.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("exceeds:", e.code)
EOF"}
